freeze_stage: Before any empirical TS11 forecasts or scores
point_adapter: centered causal EMA levels -> native q50 path -> EMA inverse point path for returns; not a return median
intervals: common last 32 forecast-error vectors with origin+5 <= current origin, empirical inverted-CDF 10/50/90 percentiles; no coverage guarantee
selection: none; fixed two checkpoints and contexts reported, no score-based promotion
nonfinancial_clock: 1-5 months, separate from stock 1-5 observed trading sessions
independence: pretraining end and exact dataset exposure unknown; all existing data previously examined; not a pristine zero-shot or prospective test
uncertainty: h5 paired normalized-MAE moving-block ranges at 1/4/8 origins; synchronized stock assets; 2000 draws, fixed normalizers, no multiplicity correction
deployment: demonstration only; no trading integration or orders
